column1: 21146§impulse§ˈɪmpʌls§Mary bought the dress on impulse.§玛丽一时**冲动**买了这件衣服。§
21147§wax§wæks§In the extracting room, rotating blades shaved away the wax that covered each cell.§在提取室里，旋转的刀片刮掉覆盖每间蜂房的**蜂蜡**。§
21148§incapacitate§ˌɪnkəˈpæsɪteɪt§The figures show that about a quarter of a million people are incapacitated with back pain every day.§数据显示，每天约有25万人因背痛而**无法正常生活**。§
21149§appear§əˈpɪə(r)§It appears that there is a grammar mistake in the composition.§这篇作文**好像**有一处语法错误。§
21150§check§tʃek§The teacher has checked Kate's answers.§老师**检查**了凯特的答案。§
21151§collect§kəˈlekt§I've collected maps and other data to prepare a guidebook.§我已**收集**了地图和其他信息准备写本指南。§
21152§attract§əˈtrækt§We kept the price low to attract more visitors here.§我们保持低价以**吸引**更多的游客前来。§
21153§describe§dɪˈskraɪb§The lecturer describes four processes which may contribute to the extinction of a species.§演讲者**描述**了可能导致一个物种灭绝的四个过程。§
21154§chunk§tʃʌŋk§Research and development now takes up a sizeable chunk of the military budget.§现在研发经费占军事预算相当大的**一部分**。§
21155§agency§ˈeɪdʒənsi§We establish links and access to the organisation's agencies.§我们同这一组织的**代理机构**建立了联系，能直接进入这些机构。§
21156§blend§blend§The music gradually blended into the city noises.§音乐逐渐和城市的噪音**混杂**在了一起。§
21157§conceive§kənˈsiːv§These scientific advances can offer a new way to test whether a conceived baby is healthy or not.§这些科学上的进步为检测**孕育**中的婴儿是否健康提供了一种新方法。§
21158§affect§əˈfekt§No activity affects more of the earth's surface than farming.§耕种是对地表**影响**最大的人类活动。§
21159§frustrate§frʌˈstreɪt§This is the place where we frustrated the enemy.§我们就是在此处**挫败**了敌人。§
21160§extend§ɪkˈstend§I extended my tour for another week here.§我把在这里的旅行时间**延长**了一周。§
21161§introduce§ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs§We've introduced a simpler price structure.§我们**引进**了一套更简易的价格体系。§
21162§advice§ədˈvaɪs§I was told to come here for advice about math courses.§有人告诉我到这里来咨询一些关于数学课程的**建议**。§
21163§attitude§ˈætɪtjuːd§We've been looking at the attitudes of various social and cultural groups towards the management of their personal finances.§我们一直关注不同的社会和文化群体对个人理财的**看法**。§
21164§deliver§dɪˈlɪvə(r)§The President delivered a televised speech to the whole nation on October 1st.§总统在10月1日向全国**发表**了电视讲话。§
21165§course§kɔːs§You can sign up for this training course in advance.§你可以提前报名参加这门培训**课程**。§
21166§match§mætʃ§Why do people spend their money on a football match?§为什么人们会花钱看足球**赛**呢？§
21167§employ§ɪmˈplɔɪ§Actually, the person did not do the work himself but rather asked a young Scotsman in his employ to design the system.§实际上那个人没有亲自做这项工作，而是**雇**了一个苏格兰年轻人来设计该系统。§
21168§pedal§ˈpedl§The riders pedaled fast along the rocky road.§车手们在崎岖的路上飞快地**骑着脚踏车**。§
21169§resident§ˈrezɪdənt§It's completely free as long as you're a resident here.§只要你是这里的**住户**，就可以完全免费（享受这项服务）。§
21170§optometrist§ɒpˈtɒmətrɪst§Students will have a chance to ask optometrists any questions at the end of the lecture.§讲座结束时，学生们将有机会向**验光师**提问。§
21171§degrade§dɪˈɡreɪd§You should not degrade yourself by telling such a lie.§你不该说这样的谎话来**降低**自己的人格。§
21172§particle§ˈpɑːtɪkl§This type of smoke contains more, smaller particles and is therefore more likely to be deposited deep in the lungs.§这种烟含有更多更小的**颗粒**，因此更可能沉淀到肺部深处。§
21173§transport§ˈtrænspɔːt§Better integration of transport systems is highly desirable and made more feasible by modern computers.§人们迫切要求**运输**系统进一步一体化，而现代计算机使这一要求更易实现。§
21174§prepare§prɪˈpeə(r)§We need two more weeks to prepare the assignment because we have had difficulty obtaining the reference books.§我们还需要两周时间来**准备**作业，因为我们在收集参考书方面遇到了困难。§
21175§registration§ˌredʒɪˈstreɪʃn§There is a strict management in the registration of a child's birth.§对新生儿的**登记**进行严格管理。§
21176§gorge§gɔːdʒ§After a long journey, he started to gorge himself on cream cakes.§走了很长一段路后，他开始**拼命吃**奶油蛋糕。§
21177§chaos§ˈkeɪɒs§The house was in chaos after the Christmas party.§圣诞晚会过后，房间**一片狼藉**。§改例句：Christmas party 前缺冠词，补 the
21178§recreational§ˌrekriˈeɪʃənl§Sports facilities are set aside in the corner for the community's recreational use.§角落里设置了运动器材，以供社区居民**娱乐**之用。§

21179§systematic§ˌsɪstəˈmætɪk§Experts in chemistry are trying to find a systematic way to destroy the organization.§化学方面的专家正致力于找出**系统**的方法去摧毁该组织。§改例句：chemical 是形容词，应为 chemistry；systematic 前缺冠词 a；find attempt 搭配不当，attempt 改为 way（译文是“方法”）
21180§subtropical§ˌsʌbˈtrɒpɪkl§The storm is now retrograding to the southeast, into subtropical latitudes.§暴风雨正在向东南方退去，进入**亚热带**地区。§
21181§detract§dɪˈtrækt§These buildings were stripped of unnecessary decoration that would detract from their primary purpose.§这些大楼已经去掉了会**削弱**其主要功能的多余装饰。§
21182§seal§siːl§Please seal the envelope and stick an eight-cent stamp on it.§请**封好**信封并贴上一张8分邮票。§
21183§depress§dɪˈpres§The recession has depressed the housing market.§经济衰退导致住房市场**不景气**。§
21184§scarce§skeəs§Many natural materials are becoming scarce.§许多天然原料濒临**枯竭**。§
21185§evidence§ˈevɪdəns§As an international student you will need to provide evidence that you can fund yourself for however long your course lasts.§作为国际学生，你需要提供**证据**，证明无论课程持续多长时间你都有足够的资金维持学业。§
21186§besides§bɪˈsaɪdz§Besides turning floral nectar into honey, these hardworking insects also pollinate crops for farmers.§**除了**将花蜜酿成蜂蜜，这些辛勤的昆虫还给农民的庄稼授粉。§
21187§waterproof§ˈwɔːtəpruːf§The waterproof match can still work after eight hours in water.§**防水**火柴放在水里八小时后仍能使用。§
21188§exclusive§ɪkˈskluːsɪv§He is part of an exclusive social circle.§他所属的社交圈子很**排外**。§
21189§majority§məˈdʒɒrəti§This treatment is not available in the vast majority of hospitals.§绝**大部分**医院都不提供这种治疗。§
21190§despite§dɪˈspaɪt§Los Angeles suffers from chronic highway blockages, despite efforts to encourage people to use public transport.§**尽管**当局积极鼓励人们使用公共交通工具，洛杉矶仍然长期存在公路拥堵现象。§
21191§dissolve§dɪˈzɒlv§None of the forms of carbon dissolves in ordinary solvents, although melted iron does dissolve carbon to a certain extent.§任何状态的碳都不**溶于**普通溶剂，但能在一定程度上溶于铁水。§
21192§release§rɪˈliːs§The thief was released on bail.§窃贼交了保释金后**获释**。§
21193§deploy§dɪˈplɔɪ§Resources must be fully deployed to bring about vigorous development in agriculture.§必须充分**利用**资源，以大力发展农业。§
21194§original§əˈrɪdʒənl§Their original house was converted into a residential college.§他们**最初**的房子被改建成了一所寄宿学校。§
21195§branch§brɑːntʃ§You may pay your account at branches of the Federal Bank.§你可以在联邦银行的**分行**支付款项。§
21196§chancellor§ˈtʃɑːnsələ(r)§Harold was the first chancellor of our university.§哈罗德是我们大学的第一任**校长**。§
21197§vertical§ˈvɜːtɪkl§The climber managed to find a support on the vertical cliff.§登山者成功地在**陡直**的峭壁上找到了一个支撑点。§
21198§herbivore§ˈhɜːbɪvɔː(r)§Ground-dwelling herbivores may return within a decade to this area.§地栖**食草动物**可能会在十年内返回这一地区。§
21199§flat§flæt§Flat shoes may cure your back pain.§穿**平底**鞋能治疗背部疼痛。§

21200§occasionally§əˈkeɪʒnəli§In social circumstances, dress has often been used as a role sign to indicate the nature and occasionally the social status of people.§在社交场合下，服饰常常被用作一种角色标记，用来展现个性，**偶尔**也用来显示人的社会地位。§
21201§accommodation§əˌkɒməˈdeɪʃn§If you are booking accommodation through the school, your course and accommodation deposit will be $200.§如果你通过学校预订**食宿**，你的课程和膳宿押金是200美元。§
21202§static§ˈstætɪk§Some people get static in their hair.§有些人的头发会产生**静电**。§
21203§section§ˈsekʃn§Here is the non-smoking section.§这里是禁烟**区**。§
21204§scale§skeɪl§In a recent research, the tropical forest has been depicted as ecologically unfit for large-scale human occupation.§最近的一项调查显示，从生态学角度来看，人们认为热带森林不适合大**规模**人群居住。§
21205§constantly§ˈkɒnstəntli§Atlas's teaching methodology is constantly revised as more is discovered about the process of learning a new language.§随着新语言学习过程中有了更多的发现，阿特拉斯的教学法**不断**得以改进。§
21206§ailment§ˈeɪlmənt§New medical technology will cure more ailments that afflict humanity.§新的医学技术可以治愈更多困扰人类的**疾病**。§
21207§adhere§ədˈhɪə(r)§Our firm has a set of standards which adhere to international requirements.§我们公司拥有一套**符合**国际要求的标准。§
21208§extracurricular§ˌekstrəkəˈrɪkjələ(r)§What role do you think extracurricular activities play in education?§你认为**课外**活动在教育中起着怎样的作用？§
21209§propel§prəˈpel§This does not mean that it was immediately used to propel rockets.§这并不意味着它立即就被用来**推进**火箭。§
21210§posture§ˈpɒstʃə(r)§Back pains can be the result of a bad posture.§背部疼痛可能是不良**姿势**造成的。§
21211§overseas§ˌəʊvəˈsiːz§Overseas students may enrol for a course at the college from their home country.§**留学**生可以在本国报名学习大学的课程。§
21212§industrialise§ɪnˈdʌstriəlaɪz§These projects are part of a larger plan to industrialise northeastern Iceland.§这些项目只是冰岛东北部**工业化**更大计划中的一部分。§
21213§empire§ˈempaɪə(r)§Isaac's epic stories charted the future of the galactic empire.§伊萨克的史诗故事描绘出了那个超级**帝国**的未来。§
21214§mechanic§məˈkænɪk§The article gave the readers a summary of the life of a mechanic.§这篇文章向读者简略介绍了一个**机修工**的生活。§
21215§fracture§ˈfræktʃə(r)§Fractures on tools indicate that a majority of ancient people were right-handed.§从工具上的**裂痕**我们可以看出，大多数古人都是惯用右手的。§
